result.reason: The change minimally reduces the notice period from 90 to 30 days and preserves the annual renewal structure, satisfying the fallback’s timing requirement. However, the clause does not include the fallback-required 5% cap on renewal price increases, so it does not reach the complete fallback position. It also lacks the preferred 60-day reminder and CPI/3% cap. Drafting is serviceable but should characterize the notice as non-renewal effective at the end of the then-current term; the current wording could be read as permitting termination on 30 days’ notice at any time.
